title: Add a git-ignored cache for whole-history commands of format 2
notes: At 27,500 tasks, `list --history`, `similar`, the duplicate check of `add`, `show` and `doctor` read every task file: 1.6 to 3.7 s (REPORT section 10.3), where the prototype cache answered in 0.12 to 0.21 s. Smallest next step: keep the parsed fields of each task file keyed by path, size and modification time, and use them in `read_task_items`.
result: Item and doctor caches outside the repository (~/.cache/tadu), per task file, validated by size, inode and timestamps; garbage collection paused for commands.
evidence: tests/test_item_cache.py and tests/test_checks_cache.py pass at 100% coverage; bench_tadu.py at 27,500 tasks: history 2.7 s to 1.0 s, show 3.2 s to 1.2 s, doctor 4.1 s to 1.3 s (REPORT section 10.3).
